policy: Immediately fill CPU-supported target, subject to memory/storage and matched-baseline dependencies

unknown_memory_allowances.interpretation: Provisional scheduling allowances, not guaranteed peak bounds

concurrency_validation: Five previously unmeasured constraint tasks launched before any completion; refill and unique archives verified with actual CPU subprocesses
preservation: Existing completed archives unchanged; interrupted tasks launch first with other slots filled; no lost-charge reset or automatic replay
failure_validation: Worker failure, archive failure, manual STOP, signal during recovery and worker exit during recovery prevent new training and preserve remaining work
scientific_code: All frozen manifest entries checked; no augmentation or loss-calibration/FLOP-cap changes
notebook_validation: ZIP/source hashes match; generated run/report/verify/preflight dispatch executed with recording launcher; all cells parse
actual_colab_gpu_validation: Not executed locally; throughput and concurrent GPU peaks remain to be measured during authorized pending runs
